description: Aggregated output from 12 parallel native-speaker-style register audits across all 3171 Hindi deck cards. Each agent reviewed ~264 cards against a rubric grading 1-10 for register authenticity. Only cards rated ≤7 are listed. Cards with rating ≤3 are high-priority swaps (nobody says this); 4-5 are textbook-formal default-swaps; 6-7 are borderline.
method: 12 parallel LLM agents each auditing ~264 cards against an urban-Hindi-speaker register rubric (Sanskrit/textbook formal vs everyday code-mixed Hindi).
